title: Cohomology of symplectic $T^n$ - reductions and compactifications of $\mathcal{M}_{0, n}$
summary: A symplectic $T^n$ - reduction on a complex Grassmann manifold $G_{n,2}$ for the canonical action of the maximal compact torus depends on the $S_n$ - orbit of a maximal chamber in a hypersimplex $Δ_{n,2}$. The chamber decomposition of $Δ_{n,2}$ is defined by the admissible polytopes, which can be realized as matroids. In our previous work we described this chamber decomposition by means of the hyperplane arrangement.
